title: ValueError: ZeroShotAgent does not support multi-input tool Calculator.
body:
There is an error when i tried to use this code.
```
tools = load_tools(['llm-math', 'python_repl'], llm)
agent = initialize_agent(tools, agent="zero-shot-react-description", llm=llm)
```
Looks like because of #3684 checking if len(self.args) == 1: in self.is_single_input. 
But, self.args of llm-math is 
```
{'args': {'title': 'Args', 'type': 'array', 'items': {}},
 'kwargs': {'title': 'Kwargs', 'type': 'object'}}
```
So, self.is_single_input return False

Is there a way to get single input llm-math?

comments.body:
I've had the same problem with all agent types. The _validate_tools method is the problem. Commenting out this line, the agent resumes work:
https://github.com/hwchase17/langchain/blob/v0.0.152/langchain/agents/agent.py#L478

I still can't figure out why.
Does anyone know why the agent shouldn't support a multiple input tool?

I tried with ConversationalAgent with a RetrivalQA tool that needs {context} and {quary} inputs.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: I created a PR [here](https://github.com/hwchase17/langchain/pull/3803) that removes the restrictive checking of multi-input in the Agent base class. Will need reviewers to +1 and merge.

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
The bug where `Tool(func=some_func)` was inferred to be a multi-input function was fixed in 0.0.153


Some tools recently landed (such as the playwright tools, some file management tools) are not compatible with older agent definitions.

I solve this problem: "ZeroShotAgent does not support multi-input tool get_repository_status." in my code just with changing of:
AgentType.ZERO_SHOT_REACT_DESCRIPTION 
to: 
AgentType.STRUCTURED_CHAT_ZERO_SHOT_REACT_DESCRIPTION

on initialization of agent:

agent = initialize_agent(
    tools,
    llm,
    agent=AgentType.STRUCTURED_CHAT_ZERO_SHOT_REACT_DESCRIPTION,
    verbose=True
)

With best regards.
